story.originalTitle: Verstappen highlights "big priority" for Red Bull in second half of F1 2026
story.summaryEn: Max Verstappen says Red Bull urgently needs to understand why its car sometimes gets worse over the course of an F1 weekend, while technical director Pierre Wache points to entry stability and mid-corner understeer as two weaknesses of the RB22.
detailZh: 维斯塔潘强调红牛在2026赛季F1下半程的“首要任务”
马克斯·维斯塔潘表示，红牛迫切需要弄清为什么其赛车有时会在一个F1周末的进程中越跑越差。技术总监皮埃尔·瓦什则指出了另一个弱点。
在F1夏休期间，马克斯·维斯塔潘落后积分榜领先者基米·安东内利多达110分。
上赛季，这位四届世界冠军从赞德沃特开始发起惊人反击，下半赛季每场大奖赛都登上领奖台，但这次他完全不期待那种情况。
红牛这次的问题更为复杂。车队赛季初就带着明显劣势起步，这在意料之中，尽管原因不同。赛季前，其自家动力单元是最大的问号，不过DM01已被证明出人意料地有竞争力。
然而在底盘方面，短板更大。再加上小红牛22的超重问题，就能明白为何根据Paceteq的数据，红牛在澳大利亚和中国纯比赛节奏上落后超过1.3秒。
在比利时和匈牙利，这一差距已缩小到每圈两成，不过维斯塔潘认为这些数字并不能说明全部情况。
在布达佩斯，这位荷兰人表示红牛似乎每个周末都会冒出一个新问题，此前他还开玩笑说，今年的种种挫折会让他在冬休期去西藏当个佛陀。
维斯塔潘表示，在匈牙利他受“赛车退化”的影响比轮胎退化更大，这是红牛需要解决的问题。
更严肃地说，维斯塔潘表示红牛需要控制住这类问题，尤其是在他在匈牙利经历了他所说的“赛车退化”之后——赛车在一个周末的进程中、甚至在一节练习中越跑越差。
“我们首先需要找到更多整体性能。然后我们需要解决我们的问题，也就是我们有时会在一个周末中损失性能，甚至从比赛开始到结束都在损失，”维斯塔潘说。
“所以，是的，那实际上是一个首要任务。”
维斯塔潘可以用一个词来概括2026赛季上半程：“艰难。”
“总的来说，非常艰难。有一些好时刻，一些我想是闪亮的时刻，但总体而言，一直很艰难。所以，我认为我们需要努力变得更稳定、更全面一些，让周末更顺利。此外，我们还需要找到更多性能。
“归根结底就这么简单。然后，除了找到更多性能之外，就是不要让现有套件出现这些问题。”
红牛也仍在与入弯不稳定和弯中转向不足作斗争。
皮埃尔·瓦什指出小红牛22的两个弱点
虽然维斯塔潘强调红牛需要防止这些负面意外，但技术总监皮埃尔·瓦什承认，小红牛22还存在几位车手都抱怨过的几个具体问题。
“我认为，就像每辆赛车一样，你会看到车手使用赛车的方式、其载荷，以及在平衡和尝试重新平衡赛车方面所能做的特性上存在一些局限。
“显然，我们像每辆赛车一样，在入弯稳定性和弯中转向不足方面存在一些局限。我们尝试通过使用一些机械手段来避免这些方面，”瓦什在接受Autosport采访时说。
维斯塔潘非常不喜欢弯中转向不足，不过红牛两位车手在这方面的反馈相当相似。
当Autosport问哈贾尔他认为最大的局限是什么时，他指出了与瓦什相同的方面。
“入弯稳定性需要解决，然后我们才能改进其余部分，”这位21岁的法国车手说。
尽管存在这些问题，红牛自赛季初的艰难阶段以来已取得显著进步。瓦什在回顾2026赛季开局那几个痛苦的比赛周末时也得出了同样的结论。
“关于赛车一开始的问题，显然相比其他一些人我们缺少一些载荷。而且我们赛车上还有一些机械小毛病，导致车手通过方向盘感觉不到赛车。我们在初期纠正了这一点。
“这花了一点时间，但它叠加在整体性能[不足]和赛车潜力之上。所以是的，我们在车手感觉方面有一些问题，这不是秘密。”
detailEn: Verstappen highlights "big priority" for Red Bull in second half of F1 2026
Max Verstappen says Red Bull urgently needs to understand why its car sometimes gets worse over the course of an F1 weekend. Technical director Pierre Wache points to another weakness
During Formula 1's summer break, Max Verstappen finds himself no fewer than 110 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli.

Last season, the four-time world champion launched a spectacular comeback from Zandvoort onwards and finished on the podium in every grand prix during the second half of the season, but this time he is absolutely not expecting that scenario.

Red Bull's problems are more complex this time around. The team started the season with a significant deficit, which had been expected, albeit for different reasons. Before the season, its own power unit was the biggest question mark, although the DM01 has proved surprisingly competitive.

On the chassis side, however, the shortcomings were greater. Add the RB22's excess weight to the equation and it becomes clear why Red Bull was more than 1.3 seconds off in terms of pure race pace in Australia and China, according to figures from Paceteq.
That gap had been reduced to two tenths per lap in Belgium and Hungary, although Verstappen believes those figures do not tell the whole story.

In Budapest, the Dutchman said that a new problem seems to emerge at Red Bull every weekend, having previously joked that all the setbacks this year would lead him to spend the winter break as a Buddha in Tibet.
Verstappen says that in Hungary he was more affected by "car degradation" than tyre degradation, an issue Red Bull needs to address

On a more serious note, Verstappen says Red Bull needs to get these kinds of issues under control, particularly after he experienced what he described as "car degradation" in Hungary, with the car getting worse over the course of the weekend and even during a session.

"We need to first find more overall performance. And then we need to fix our problems, where we sometimes just lose performance over a weekend, or even from the start of the race to the end,” Verstappen said.
"So, yeah, that is actually a big priority."
Verstappen can sum up the first half of the 2026 season in one word: "Tough."

"In general, it’s been very tough. Some good moments, some bright and shining moments, I guess, but in overall, it has been tough. So, I think we need to try and be more solid, a bit more all-round, to have more straightforward weekends. Plus, we need to find more performance.
"It’s as simple as that at the end of the day. Then, besides finding more performance, just not having these issues with the current package."
Red Bull is also still struggling with corner entry instability and mid-corner understeer
Pierre Wache identifies two weaknesses of the RB22

While Verstappen stresses that Red Bull needs to prevent these negative surprises, technical director Pierre Wache acknowledges that the RB22 also has several specific problems that both drivers have complained about.

"I think, as with every racing car, you see some limitations in how the drivers can use the car, the load of it, and the characteristics of what you can do in terms of balance and trying to rebalance the car.

"Clearly, we have some limitations, like every racing car, in terms of stability on [corner] entry and mid-corner understeer. And we try to avoid those aspects by using some mechanical tools to achieve it," Wache said when asked by Autosport.
Verstappen strongly dislikes mid-corner understeer, although the feedback from both Red Bull drivers is fairly similar in that respect.
When Autosport asked Hadjar what he considers the biggest limitation, he pointed to the same areas as Wache.
"Entry stability needs to be solved, and then we can improve the rest," the 21-year-old French driver said.

Despite these problems, Red Bull has made significant progress since the difficult opening phase of the season. Wache reaches the same conclusion when reflecting on the painful opening race weekends of 2026.

"Regarding the issues with the car at the beginning, clearly we were missing some load compared to some others. And we also had some mechanical gremlins on the car, which meant the driver didn’t feel the car through the steering. We corrected that at the beginning.
"It took a little bit of time, but it came on top of the overall performance [deficit] and the potential of the car. So yeah, we had some issues with the drivers’ feeling, that is not a secret."

据Paceteq数据，红牛在澳大利亚和中国纯比赛节奏落后超过1.3秒，在比利时和匈牙利已缩小到每圈两成。
瓦什承认小红牛22存在入弯稳定性和弯中转向不足的限制，哈贾尔也指出入弯稳定性需要先解决。

relatedItems.originalTitle: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
relatedItems.summaryEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix. The collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1以全新汤米·希尔费格系列在美国大奖赛上尽显得克萨斯风情
凯迪拉克与汤米·希尔费格发布了一个以得克萨斯为灵感的五件式牛仔（denim）系列
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——图片由汤米·希尔费格提供
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队及其合作伙伴汤米·希尔费格在奥斯汀美国大奖赛前发布了一个德克萨斯主题的服装系列，这让我们所有人都兴奋不已。
汤米·希尔费格与凯迪拉克一级方程式车队的奥斯汀系列于本周二早些时候开售。但这并不是这两个品牌第一次推出与比赛相关的产品。他们已经在同一城市系列中推出了迈阿密和墨西哥系列，并且还计划在11月推出拉斯维加斯系列。
不出意外的话，牛仔布是这些单品的核心，它们带有镀铬细节和汤米·希尔费格红白蓝配色的V形美国国旗。
男士可以购买基于经典卡车司机风格的浅色水洗牛仔夹克。女士则有一件带银色箔涂层的牛仔背心。一件T恤、一件背心和一顶牛仔帽让这个系列更加让人难以拒绝。你知道还有什么同样让人难以拒绝吗？可以看到凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯在日落时分向镜头举起一顶牛仔帽，背上印有V形旗帜图案。
你还需要什么来说服你？
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——由汤米·希尔费格提供
“在我们的美国根源上增添一点乐趣”
汤米·希尔费格首席设计官李·霍尔曼表示，设计师们从该品牌最受欢迎的两件单品入手。
他说：“我们从 Tommy 衣橱中的标志性单品——牛仔夹克和白 T 恤——入手，并研究了如何以奥斯汀的城市气质为灵感对它们进行重新演绎。”
“关键在于把熟悉的单品赋予全新的视角，同时坚守我们经典美式酷感的品牌基因。”
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队首席品牌顾问卡西迪·托里斯表示，在得克萨斯州举行的这场比赛让两个品牌都有了发挥空间。
“奥斯汀让我们有机会在美国根源上玩得更尽兴一些，”托里斯说，“这是为比赛周末打造的粉丝服饰，但设计上力求在围场之外也能长久穿着。”
汤米·希尔费格是凯迪拉克的官方服装和车迷服饰合作伙伴，车手塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯——博塔斯的队友——也是该品牌的全球男装大使。奥斯汀站是美国车队本赛季继五月初迈阿密大奖赛之后的第二个主场比赛，佩雷斯期待能在离家更近的地方驾驶。
“我们距离能够与前车竞争还差大约一秒到一秒半，我认为我们现在真正需要的是一辆更强的赛车，”佩雷斯在新加坡站后表示。“其他一切都在按预期推进，我相信我们作为一个团队会达到目标。我非常期待奥斯汀和墨西哥，我们的两场主场比赛。
“奥斯汀是车队的主场，墨西哥对我而言将格外特别，在家乡观众面前比赛并迎来第300场大奖赛。那将是一个非常特别的周末。”
凯迪拉克在首个赛季仍在等待它的首个积分。
detailEn: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
Cadillac and Tommy Hilfiger have unveiled a five-piece denim collection inspired by Texas
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix in Austin, and it's making us all kinds of excited.

The Tommy Hilfiger x Cadillac Formula 1 Team Austin collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week. But this isn't the first time the two brands have released something in connection with a race. They have already released Miami and Mexico collections in the same city series, and a Las Vegas drop is also planned for November.
Denim, maybe unsurprisingly, is the heart of these pieces, which carry chrome detailing and a chevron-shaped American flag in Tommy Hilfiger's red, white and blue.

Men can buy a light-wash denim jacket based on the classic trucker style. For women, there's a denim vest with a silver foil coating. A T-shirt, a tank top and a denim cap make the range even harder to say no to. And do you know what else does the same? Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas can be seen tipping a cowboy hat to the camera at sunset, with the chevron flag design across his back.
What more do you need to persuade you?
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
"A little more fun with our American roots"
Lee Holman, Tommy Hilfiger's chief design officer, said the designers started with two of the brand's most popular pieces.
"We started with icons of the Tommy wardrobe – the denim jacket and the white T-shirt – and looked at how we could rework them inspired by the character of Austin," he said.
"It's about taking familiar pieces and giving them a fresh point of view, while staying grounded in our classic American cool DNA."
Cassidy Towriss, chief brand adviser for the Cadillac Formula 1 Team, said the race in Texas gave both brands room to play.
"Austin gives us a chance to have a little more fun with our American roots," Towriss said. "It's fanwear made for race weekend, but designed to live well beyond the paddock."

Tommy Hilfiger is Cadillac's official apparel and fanwear partner, with driver Sergio Perez, Bottas's team-mate, also the brand's global menswear ambassador. With the Austin race being the American team's second home race of the season after the Miami Grand Prix earlier this season in early May, Perez is looking forward to driving a little closer to home.

“We are still lacking around one to one-and-a-half seconds to be able to compete with the cars ahead, and I think what we really need now is a stronger car underneath us," Perez said following his Singapore campaign. "Everything else has been progressing as expected, and I’m confident we will get there as a team. I’m really looking forward to Austin and Mexico, our two home races.
"Austin for the team, and Mexico will be particularly special for me, racing in front of my home crowd and reaching 300 grands prix. It’s going to be a very special weekend.”
Cadillac is still waiting for its first points in its debut season.
